thesis: Deliver a controlled cinematic warehouse arc where split-position beam coverage and earned warm accents frame the title as a singular gravitational pull toward one shared center.

artist_branding.summary: CamelPhat and Josh Gigante point toward dark melodic club storytelling: disciplined low-key foundations, selective high-impact moments, and polished cinematic pacing rather than maximal constant effects.
visual_cues: Dark charcoal and cold-blue base with teal and violet tension layers
Wide split-position sweeps to create intentional spatial contrast
Amber and white deployed as earned peak language, not baseline color
do_not_copy: Do not recreate exact branded stage packages, visuals, or known headline show cue structures.

motifs: Geometry motif: split beams explore room extremes before converging on center anchors
Color motif: cold blue and charcoal body with amber/white as singular payoff tones
Movement motif: section-specific sweep routes with deliberate buildup from tight to full-span coverage

visual_direction.color_story: Keep instrumental phrases in cold-blue, teal, and charcoal, then unlock amber and white only at emotional or structural peak milestones.
visual_direction.motion_story: Use 2-bar and 1-bar transitions to increase urgency across sections while preserving coherent directional sweep narratives.
visual_direction.staging_story: Treat Sharpy/BSW as dual protagonists in split coverage, with Profile and PAR layers reinforcing architecture and peak punctuation.

must_include: Frequent split-position sweeps where Sharpy and BSW target different zones
Clear section-level route variation so each act covers distinct room geometry
Peak white moments reserved for true climax only
avoid: Flat same-position unison for entire sections in high-energy acts
Unbroken strobe-heavy blocks that collapse dynamic contrast
Warm color dominance during low-energy or stripped passages
